purpose: Re-express MA7 events as readable causal market states, add compression-to-expansion, and audit signal frequency before any trading strategy is written.

data.source_contract: P0R2 priority union of Binance Vision monthly and immutable Binance API legacy partitions

causal_features.slope_percentile: current normalized_slope percentile within the same symbol and continuous block over trailing 252 observations including t
causal_features.er_percentile: current ER20 percentile within the same symbol and continuous block over trailing 252 observations including t
causal_features.rv20_percentile: current 20-day annualized realized volatility percentile within the same symbol and continuous block over trailing 252 observations including t
causal_features.compression_percentile_lag1: percentile of compression_ratio over trailing 252 observations, lagged one day
causal_features.expansion_percentile: current expansion_ratio percentile over trailing 252 observations including t

market_state.UP_TREND: close > SMA30, normalized_slope > 0, slope_percentile > 0.60, and er_percentile > 0.60
market_state.DOWN_TREND: close < SMA30, normalized_slope < 0, slope_percentile <= 0.40, and er_percentile > 0.60
market_state.CHOP: er_percentile <= 0.40 and neither UP_TREND nor DOWN_TREND

pre_registered_filters.ALIGNED_STATE: long only in UP_TREND; short only in DOWN_TREND
pre_registered_filters.ALIGNED_LOW_VOL: ALIGNED_STATE and RV quintile in Q1 or Q2
pre_registered_filters.ALIGNED_HIGH_VOL: ALIGNED_STATE and RV quintile in Q4 or Q5

frequency_audit.common_calendar: first through last P1-eligible UTC date
